newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk c.bank injects 31 trln lira via 7-day repos.
newsitem.headline: Turk c.bank injects 31 trln lira via 7-day repos.

text.p: 1015 GMT - Turkish central bank injected 31 trln lira at 74 pct via a 7-day repo auction to ease 84.8 trln lira shortage caused by banks' 155.4 trln lira auction payment to treasury. * O/N money rate leapt to 71.63 pct from Tuesday's avg 53.76. * Lira eased to 148,800 per dollar from Tuesday's 148,670 close as c.bank raised its dollar rate for banks' compulsory fx transfers to 148,800 lira from 148,650 close. * Yield on most active April 1, 1998 paper at 105.30 pct, down from 106.69 pct in Tuesday's auction.
